about: Every frame of the plan-weight board as its own PNG at native size: <option>_<scene>_z<zoom>.png are 1:1 crops of the game's own frames (520 x 300 at zoom 1, 400 x 240 at 0.35, the same crop for every option of a scene), context_<scene>_z0.35.png whole 1280 x 720 frames of P0.

frames.title: P0 · Today  ·  road  ·  zoom 1.0
frames.caption: The reference: the selected path 1.6 px, its carry-on 1.0 px dashed, nodes 3 px, the others' plans 1.0 px with 1.9 px nodes, the range of motion's rim 0.9 px.. Scene 'road': the selected tank's 2-step plan on the road by the bridge, a second tank's 2-step plan beside it (the quieter one). 1:1 crop of the game's own frame.
